title: Paul's Boutique
notes:
Recorded at [l=Mario G's]
Mixed at [url=https://www.discogs.com/label/265540-Record-Plant-NYC]Record Plant[/url]
Hello Brooklyn [B7e] recorded at the [url=https://www.discogs.com/label/275032-The-Opium-Den]Opium Den[/url]

Inner-sleeve: 
© 1989 [l=Brooklyn Dust Music] [....] © ℗ 1989 [l=Capitol Records, Inc.]

Labels:
℗ © 1989 [l=Capitol Records, Inc.]
Mfg. by  [l=Capitol Records, Inc.], a subsidiary of [l=Capitol Industries-EMI, Inc.], U.S.A.

Back cover sticker: 
℗ © 1989 [l=Capitol Records, Inc.] Manufactured by [l=Capitol Records, Inc.] a subsidiary of [l=Capitol-EMI Music, Inc.]

Front cover sticker:
Special Limited Edition 8-Panel Jacket

Catalog number on spine: C1-92844
Catalog number on labels: C1-91743

Direct Metal Mastering (DMM).

Side B has "E A S T" embossed under the label rotating each letter at every 90 degrees around the label. 

Track B7 is a nine-part medley.

This version was released with an the eight-panel gatefold-style jacket. Some copies were released with a 'Special Limited Edition' sticker affixed to the front cover and a UPC barcode sticker affixed to the back cover.

There is [url=https://www.discogs.com/Beastie-Boys-Pauls-Boutique/release/1992136]another version[/url] with a different two-panel gatefold-style jacket and a different barcode number that is printed directly on the back cover.

identifiers.description: Stamped around side B center hole
